T · One tracker per project 6/6

Every project has one tracker page covering all its proposals, readable at a glance: filters across the top, work shown as blocks, and a list when the detail matters. A proposal gets a tracker of its own only when the sponsor asks for one.

Exit: common-rules publishes its one tracker, the card and conformance read it, and the per-proposal pages are retired except where the sponsor asked for one.
